crew.overview: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.
crew.title: The Truman Show

details.biography: Antonia Proscia is a production accountant known for The Last Airbender (2010), Cloverfield, Four Brothers, The Day the Earth Stood Still (2008), Ghost Town, Love Guru, How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days, Gulliver's Travels (2010), Last Action Hero, Enchanted, Zoolander, The Bone Collector, The First Wives Club, Boys on the Side, Sliver, Freejack, Loose Cannons, and The Godfather III, among others.
details.name: Antonia Proscia
